summary: knowledge-graph repo: lazy-loading graph explorer UI

message.content: Build a graph explorer UI that doesn't load all nodes at once.

content.text: The UI now requests /api/graph/overview, which returns only the top nodes by importance (PageRank blended with how many conversations mention the concept), diversified across communities. Clicking a node calls /api/graph/node/{id} and merges that neighborhood into the force-directed graph, so the browser only ever holds what you explored. The side panel shows related concepts, typed relations with evidence, the conversations that mention the node and a timeline.

message.content: Add something that helps discover new things.

content.text: Added a Discover panel computed from the graph structure: bridge concepts with high betweenness that connect different communities, unexpected links between communities with high NPMI, hidden connections (concept pairs never discussed together but sharing many neighbors, scored with Adamic–Adar) and forgotten topics you haven't mentioned in months.
